description: A signed-in shopper keeps invoice PDFs in the shop. POST /documents takes multipart/form-data with the fields title and file; GET /documents/{id}/file gives the stored file back as an attachment.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploading a PDF with a title returns 201 with the document id, the title, the file name and its size in bytes.
Downloading a document returns exactly the uploaded file: the same name, type application/pdf and the same size.
A file that is not a PDF is refused with 415 and the error PDF_ONLY.

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Limit is 5 MB per file for now.
